data.name: Nina Energy
data.description: Nina Energy Limited is an Ecuadorian startup (founded 2021, formerly Andes Bioenergy) that designs and deploys proprietary pyrolysis reactors for converting agro-industrial and forestry residues into biochar for permanent carbon removal. In November 2025 it launched a pyrolysis plant near Cotopaxi with German partner atmosfair, and it is part of the remove Cohort 2 accelerator, selling verified biochar carbon credits.
